label: Calm Home

modes: Apps I choose (up to six, picked on the TV)
appSelection.metric: Android foreground time aggregated with queryAndAggregateUsageStats
appSelection.eligible: Launchable installed/preinstalled apps, excluding Home launchers and utility/input packages
appSelection.fallback: Local successful launch counts, local recency, app label, package ID
appSelection.chosenApps: Shown in the order picked; missing apps are skipped, not replaced
appSelection.historyLimit: Android keeps daily records for about ten days and older days in weekly or monthly records, so the window edges are approximate

validation: Built in a Linux container with the SDK's d8 8.2.2 and apksigner from build-tools 34 and the same local signing key. The pipeline was checked by rebuilding version 1.1's classes.dex byte for byte. aapt2 was not available there, so the binary manifest is version 1.1's aapt2 output with only versionCode/versionName changed; a rebuild with launcher/Build-Windows.ps1 will produce a different checksum. v1/v2/v3 signatures and resources.arsc alignment verified. Choose apps, Portuguese labels and the aggregated usage window not yet tried on a physical TV
languages: Portuguese (when the TV language is Portuguese)
